check: T=t0000-basic.sh t0001-init.sh t1300-config.sh t1500-rev-parse.sh t5500-fetch-pack.sh t5601-clone.sh t5700-protocol-v1.sh
configure:
printf '%s' "$1" > config.mak; printf "CURL_LDFLAGS = %s
CURL_CFLAGS = %s
" "$(pkg-config --static --libs libcurl)" "$(pkg-config --cflags libcurl)" >> config.mak; printf "LDFLAGS += %s
" "${LDFLAGS-}" >> config.mak

prefix = /
RUNTIME_PREFIX = YesPlease
INSTALL_SYMLINKS = YesPlease
NO_GETTEXT = YesPlease
NEEDS_LIBICONV = YesPlease
NO_RUST = YesPlease
NO_TCLTK = YesPlease
PERL_PATH = /usr/bin/perl
PYTHON_PATH = /usr/bin/python3
USE_LIBPCRE =

checks: alias.rootbeer-check=!set -eu; directory=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$directory"' EXIT; git init -q "$directory/repository"; git -C "$directory/repository" -c user.name=Rootbeer -c user.email=rootbeer@example.invalid commit -qm initial --allow-empty; git clone -q "$directory/repository" "$directory/clone"; git -C "$directory/clone" fsck --strict; test -x "$(git --exec-path)/git-remote-https"
